items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: And the best one, of course, was Lorenzo Teo.

ctx.x: Yes, a regular set thing. And he was terrific. They gave him stuff on the violin, breaks to do on that, and featured his singing and everything else. That's when they had very much larger group. They grew up to about a ten-piece band. The other guitarists around New Orleans proper were none that I know of except the McKay brothers, which were both white, and then all the Negro bands. And they all, as I say, I don't remember a banjo until much later when Johnny St. Cyr began using that six-string. Now, the... And…
